title: Ninja Sorceress in Battle
description: A female ninja with long flowing green hair leaps dynamically through a ruined wooden Japanese-style building at night. She wears a red and green outfit with glowing pink tattoos on her back and arms, wields a large curved blade in one hand, and casts a pink heart-shaped energy orb with the other while spectral purple figures and arrows appear below her.
prompt: A fierce female ninja with long flowing green hair and glowing pink tattoos on her back and arms, wearing a revealing red and green outfit with a face mask, leaping dynamically in mid-air through a destroyed wooden Japanese temple at night. She holds a large curved katana in one hand and casts a glowing pink heart-shaped energy orb with the other. Purple spectral ghost figures and pink energy arrows surround her, dramatic smoke, sparks and blood splatter effects, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
